cameraCuts.note: frames in which the camera alone moved a figure by the cut line or more (a cut or a whip); swaps and jerks that fall with one are left out

wash.note: the wash of the Save Sphere card (an HTML veil the canvas strips cannot show): where it was up, and the jerks whose step happened under it. A jerk with covered:true is excused by continuity.wash in the policy and is not in the summary or the verdict; every jerk in this file carries the wash over its step when there was one.

smear.note: planned smears (continuity.smear in the policy): the engine logs every cut it plans as a smear on a big change; a swap that matches a log entry (same figure, same pair, inside its window) is not a snap and a jerk of at most maxJerkPx at it is not counted. Every other fast swap is judged as before.
